## Executive summary

This fictional audit summarizes revenue variance, capital expenditure controls, and local tax compliance checks across the enterprise. The figures are synthetic and exist only to exercise the local document-ingestion and retrieval agents.

## Key findings

- Quarterly revenue was INR 85.4 million against a plan of INR 82.0 million, a positive variance of 4.1%.
- Capital expenditure utilization was 91% of the approved Q3 envelope.
- Two regional cost centers require follow-up because supporting purchase orders were not attached to the ledger entries.

## Control recommendations

1. Require purchase-order references for every capital expenditure transaction.
2. Reconcile revenue and tax ledgers before the monthly close is approved.
3. Retain the reviewer decision, evidence checksum, and corrective-action owner in the audit trail.

# Air-Gapped Sovereign AI System Architecture Specs

Department: R&D / Engineering
Classification: Confidential
Document ID: RND-ARCH-2026
Revision: 2.1

documentTitle: Air-Gapped Sovereign AI System Architecture Specs
text:
## Architecture summary

The platform runs on a private LAN with no permitted external cloud transmission. Inference services expose local endpoints for Ollama, llama.cpp, and vLLM-compatible workers. Requests are routed through a policy layer before reaching a model.

documentTitle: Air-Gapped Sovereign AI System Architecture Specs
text:
## Runtime requirements

- The vector store is persisted as a local JSON index with 768-dimensional embeddings.
- RBAC and ABAC checks must run before document retrieval and before tool execution.
- GPU allocation must account for model VRAM, current utilization, and a safety reserve.
- Every agent execution emits a correlation ID, input summary, selected model, confidence, and audit result.

documentTitle: Air-Gapped Sovereign AI System Architecture Specs
text:
## Recovery and observability

The runtime should degrade to deterministic local embeddings when an embedding daemon is unavailable. Health checks must distinguish `READY`, `DEGRADED`, and `FAILED` states. A failed specialist may not silently fabricate a result; the orchestrator must return a truthful fallback or an explicit error.

## Policy summary

## Guidelines

- Compensation decisions require an approved role level, location band, and documented review owner.
- Remote-work allowances are reimbursed only when the expense is within the quarterly policy limit.

# Sovereign AI Security Governance Charter

SOVEREIGN AI — SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT
Department: All
Classification: Internal
Document ID: SEC-GOV-2026
Effective Date: 2026-01-15

## Purpose

This charter defines the mandatory controls for safe operation of the air-gapped enterprise AI workbench. The document is synthetic and is intended to ground policy, compliance, and explainability demonstrations.

## Mandatory controls

1. External cloud transmission of enterprise data is prohibited.
2. Least-privilege RBAC and department-aware ABAC checks must run on every protected route.
3. Confidential and restricted documents require a matching department scope and sensitivity allowance.
4. High-risk tools require human approval before execution.
5. Agent outputs must include source citations or clearly state that the knowledge store could not verify the claim.
6. Audit records must include the user, action, resource, status, timestamp, and correlation ID.

## Incident handling

When a policy violation is detected, deny the request, write a `DENIED` audit event, preserve the evidence needed for review, and notify the responsible administrator. Do not bypass a policy because a downstream model requests it.

## Verification note

This is synthetic governance content for local testing.
